text: Go find the sweets ingredients for Lefina!
Lefina seems to have failed to make the sweets.\nGo find the ingredients you collected earlier once again!
Seems like the sweets ingredients you collected are\nbecoming scarce. Go to Sweet Hades and discover the cause!
You encountered a monster called Jeandoux during the\ninvestigation. He's furious and goes on a rampage\nfor unknown reasons. Calm him down!
Return to Sofya City to report to Lefina about the monster\nthat is hindering you from collecting the ingredients.
